functions.name: Det3x3From4x4
functions.summary: Computes the determinant of the upper-left 3x3 submatrix of a 4x4 matrix whose four rows are read as 16-byte vectors from a1. An alignment guard chooses between aligned __m128 row loads at byte offsets 0x0, 0x10, 0x20 and 0x30 and unaligned upper-64-bit-half loads (_mm_loadh_ps) at byte offsets +8, +24, +40 and +56. The determinant is evaluated with SSE shuffle/multiply/subtract/add cofactor expansion, horizontally reduced, and returned as a double. Pure SSE math helper; no calls, no globals.

operations.description: Alignment guard on the matrix pointer: if (a1 & 0xF) != 0 the pointer is not 16-byte aligned and the unaligned load path is taken; otherwise the aligned __m128 path is used.
Aligned path: load the four 16-byte rows of the 4x4 matrix as __m128 at byte offsets 0x0, 0x10, 0x20 and 0x30 into v1, v2, v3 and v4 respectively.
Unaligned path: load each row's upper 64 bits via _mm_loadh_ps from byte offsets +8, +24, +40 and +56 into v2, v1, v3 and v4 respectively.
First determinant stage over rows v3 and v4: v5 = shuffle(v3, 57); v6 = v4 * v5; v7 = shuffle(v4, 78); v8 = shuffle(v7, 57); v9 = v7 * v5; v10 = v5 * v8; v11 = shuffle(v10, 78) - v10.

Second determinant stage folding in row v2 and v1: v12 = shuffle(v2, 57); v13 = shuffle(v12, 57); v14 = (v12 * (shuffle(v9, 57) - shuffle(v6, 78)) + v11 * v13 + shuffle(v13, 57) * (v9 - shuffle(v6, 57))) * v1.
Horizontal reduction of the SSE determinant result: v15 = v14 + movehl(v14); scalar = v15[0] - shuffle(v15, v15, 1)[0].
Return the scalar determinant of the upper-left 3x3 submatrix widened to a double.

The caller's matrix layout is unproven: rows are read at 16-byte stride from a1 and the first three columns are treated as the 3x3 submatrix, but no caller or static call site establishes the concrete structure.
Owner is unknown (pure math helper); no class or module attribution is available from the packet.

Negate the distance (sign-flip XOR with global 0x005D8AD0) and store the plane D component into the output plane (lane 3 of the quad, byte offset 0xC).
